title: EXP-07 Post-Training Diagnostic and Failure Analysis Register

failure_hypotheses_ranked.hypothesis: Severe Parent-Scene Scarcity & Dataset Insufficiency for Tail Classes
failure_hypotheses_ranked.summary: Classes AF, OF, RF, Eddy, and HM appear in very few parent scenes (1 to 4 parents in TRAIN). Without spatial or acoustic diversity, features cannot generalize to unobserved scenes.
Parent scene s1a-iw-grd-vv-20220201... (9 tiles) suffered complete confusion of MCC and POW into BG and WS, dropping its mIoU to 0.0069 and heavily skewing the DEV macro-average.

failure_hypotheses_ranked.hypothesis: Severe Visual & Semantic Class Ambiguity Between Lookalikes
failure_hypotheses_ranked.summary: 95.4% of Eddy pixels were classified as other dark slick phenomena (BS and LWA), reflecting identical SAR dampening signatures without auxiliary context.

failure_hypotheses_ranked.hypothesis: Extreme Scale Imbalance for Anthropogenic Point Targets (HM)
failure_hypotheses_ranked.summary: HM accounts for only 0.021% of TRAIN pixels (985 pixels total). A 4-stage UNet without point-target attention dilutes isolated targets at the bottleneck.

failure_hypotheses_ranked.hypothesis: Sampler Replacement Redundancy vs Diversity Gap
failure_hypotheses_ranked.summary: Candidate F achieved sufficient sample draw frequency, but drawing the same 2-3 tiles repeatedly led to memorization rather than generalizable representation.

replicate_authorization.rationality: Seed 42 protocol is validated and reproducible. Replicate Seed 101 is authorized under Phase C10 to empirically measure seed-to-seed stochastic sampling variance, strictly NOT as an unprincipled rescue run.
replicate_authorization.prohibitions: Do NOT modify hyperparameters, do NOT evaluate holdout, do NOT run hyperparameter sweep.

final_decision: DECISION A: PASS — Seed42 is protocol-valid and scientifically interpretable; next replicate experiment authorized
